    @pytest.mark.xdist_group(name="group2")
    @allure.title("Create custom bot with condition")
    def test_create_custom_bot_with_conditions(self, page: Page, create_session):
        login_page = LoginPage(page)
        bots_page = BotsPage(page)
        bot_wizard = BotWizard(page)
        bot_details_page = BotDetailsPage(page)
        bots_api = BotsApi()
        bot_card = "Manual setup"
        initial_volume = "10"
        take_profit = "10"
        stop_loss = "15"
        trailing_sell = "1"
        trailing_buy = "1"
        execution_type = "Passive limit"
        martingale_percent = "10"
        price_deviation = "5"
        maximum_trade_requests = "2"
        indicator_code = "Bollinger Bands"
        candle_pattern = "Hammer"
        high_low_percent = "5"
    
        with allure.step("Test preparation"):
            login_page.goto()
            create_session()
    
        with allure.step("Go to bots page"):
            bots_page.goto(endpoint=bots_page.slug)
    
        with allure.step("Open create bot wizard"):
            bots_page.click_create_new_bot_btn()
    
        with allure.step("Fill credentials step"):
            bot_wizard.insert_bot_name(self.custom_with_condition_bot_name)
            bot_wizard.select_exchange_coin(coin_num=1)
            bot_wizard.click_next_market_btn()
    
        with allure.step("Fill market step"):
            bot_wizard.select_exchange_market(checkbox_num=3)
            bot_wizard.click_next_trade_settings_btn()
    
        with allure.step("Fill bot trade settings"):
            bot_wizard.select_bot_type(bot_card=bot_card)
            bot_wizard.insert_initial_volume(initial_volume)
            bot_wizard.insert_take_profit(take_profit)
            bot_wizard.insert_stop_loss(stop_loss)
            bot_wizard.insert_trailing_sell(trailing_sell)
            bot_wizard.insert_trailing_buy(trailing_buy)
    
        with allure.step("Fill bot martingale"):
            bot_wizard.toggle_martingale_switch()
            bot_wizard.insert_martingale_percent(martingale_percent)
            bot_wizard.insert_price_deviation(price_deviation)
            bot_wizard.insert_maximum_trade_requests(maximum_trade_requests)
    
        # with allure.step("Fill bot pivot point"): TODO Remove after fix
        #     bot_wizard.toggle_pivot_point_switch()
    
        with allure.step("Fill bot indicator"):
            bot_wizard.click_add_new_indicator_btn()
            page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
